classification: PROVISIONAL GAME MECHANICS — not physiology or biomechanics

arena.boundary_rule: clamp to square boundary and reflect the corresponding heading component

ambient_walking.heading_jitter_distribution: independent uniform per ambient control interval
ambient_walking.seed_rule: trial_seed + 1 in a distinct environment-owned Generator
ambient_walking.dependency_rule: body state, mechanics, and environment RNG only; no sensory or attack geometry

takeoff.trigger: previously held escape_request at interval start

impact.timing: after environment motion and before decoding at the ending control boundary
impact.authority_note: G-BIO is based on neural output and command authority, not this provisional outcome

disclaimer: These mechanics establish neither fly physiology nor realistic biomechanics and are not tuned to improve G-BIO.
